title: One nation's organisation (OA) sheets: every counter, by formation
description: data/oa/<nation>.json. A formation is one OA sheet (a division, a brigade group, or a heading such as 'Unassigned Artillery Units'). Values as printed (4.43, 4.45b, 4.45c in the chart sets).

basic_morale.description: Printed basic morale; null where the sheet says the units take another unit's morale

basic_morale_alt.description: The value printed in parentheses beside it, if any (see rules/10-units-and-state.md, morale)

attached.description: Counters whose home is another sheet but which this sheet lists as attached (not assigned) to one of its units; each counter has one id, on its home sheet

id_code.description: Key into tables/unit-characteristics.json for this nation; null where the sheet prints none (a unit listed for attachment, whose code is on its home sheet)

vehicle.description: Reconnaissance units only (a Recce or Reconnaissance row of tables/unit-characteristics.json): the breakdown class of the unit's own TOE points (21.1x), keyed into tables/breakdown-adjustments.json; none means they never break down (camels, motorcycles). Tank points added under 20.5 break down as tanks at their own model's BAR (rules/90-special.md, R-125)

echelon.description: Headquarters only: the formation level the HQ commands. Regiment HQs are brigade equivalents (9.22) and say brigade; Kampfgruppe and Gruppe HQs say battle-group (rules/95-abstract-logistics-and-air.md, R-124)

attachment_parent.description: Headquarters only: the parent keys of tables/max-attachments.json (rows of this nation) that cap its non-assigned attachments (19.5); several where the chart splits a type by Game-Turn, the row whose turns hold the current turn applies; empty where no row fits (the corps HQ). Every battalion-equivalent non-HQ unit uses its nation's battalion row, so carries no field

organisation.description: Headquarters only: the parent key of tables/formation-organisation.json (rows of this nation) giving its formation's organisation (19.3); where the chart has several types by Game-Turn, the row whose turns hold the current turn applies. null for an HQ with no row (battle groups, artillery commands, garrisons, the corps): limited by its O/A notes (19.2)

equivalent.description: Stacking equivalent (SPI 9.22-9.24), given only where the unit's unit-characteristics row says by-unit

toe_mark.description: Printed instead of a TOE: N = the maximum TOE for its ID code; U@n / O@n = under / over strength at n points

parent.description: The unit it is assigned to on the sheet; null for the formation's top unit or an unassigned unit

arrives.description: Printed arrival (the sheet prints OpStage/Game-Turn); deployed = D, placed before play begins; null where the sheet prints none

replaces.description: A historical reorganisation the sheet prints as one counter replacing another: at this counter's arrives (or, where that is null, when an assigns brings its parent under the replaced counter's top HQ) the replaced counter leaves play and this one takes its hex, TOE points, assigned and attached units (rules/70-organisation.md, replacement counters). A scenario that places this counter (R-096) starts with the replacement made

assigns.description: With replaces: units from other sheets that become assigned to this counter when the replacement is made, with the units under them

commander.description: General Rommel's counter only (31.0, R-135): a piece of its own, not an HQ and not a combat unit, that the sheet does not print; id_code is null and these values stand in for a unit-characteristics row

moves_as.description: A truck row of tables/truck-characteristics.json, for movement and breakdown (31.0: 4-wheel drive, AM radio only)

stack_morale_bonus.description: Added to the morale of every unit in his hex in combat

escort_cpa_bonus.description: Added to the CPA of a unit he starts and spends a whole OpStage with

recall_roll.description: Two-dice total at the start of a Game-Turn that sends him to Germany for that turn

morale.description: Only where the sheet gives this unit a morale other than the formation's
